{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Fire Dragon''' (丙辰, ''hinoe tatsu''; onyomi ''heishin'') is the 53rd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 53rd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Wood Rabbit|ja|乙卯}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Fire Snake|ja|丁巳}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丙'' is Yang Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''辰'' (Dragon) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Fire Dragon (丙辰)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): bǐngchén
** Cantonese (Jyutping): bing3 san4
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoe-tatsu
*** On'yomi: heishin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): byeongjin (병진)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Bính Thìn

==Months of Yang Fire Dragon==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 3 or 8 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Mizunoto (癸)|ja|癸|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoe (戊)|ja|戊|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)|2=ja|3=戊|4=zh|5=戊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bo}}), the month of {{ill|March|en|March|qid=Q110|lt=March}} is designated as the month of {{ill|Yang Fire Dragon|ja|丙辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yang Fire Dragon|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term “month” may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}} until the day before {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}}) as applicable.
==Days of Yang Fire Dragon==
==={{nihongo|selection days|選日|senjitsu}}===
The selected day for {{ill|Yang Fire Dragon|ja|丙辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yang Fire Dragon|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the gap day of {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hassen}}.
